document_title: Official Rule Revision Announcement (ルール改定のお知らせ)
original_japanese_quotation_or_note: 従来「この効果はゲーム中に1回しか使えない」等と表記されていた効果は、〔ゲームに1回：同名〕という記述に統一・変更されています。〔ターンに1回：同名〕／〔ゲームに1回：同名〕：同一のカード名を持つカード全体で、指定された期間内に1回のみ発揮できる効果。
english_translation_or_summary: Effects previously written as "This effect can only be used once per game" are unified/changed to [Once per Game: Same Name]. [Once per Turn: Same Name] / [Once per Game: Same Name]: Effects that can be activated only once within the specified period across all cards sharing the identical card name.
supported_engine_behavior: Establishes player-scoped same-name tracking across all physical card instances with identical canonical name for turn/game duration.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does not establish individual card rulings for specific cards; does not mandate Stage 4 internal engine commit label.

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation_or_note: 防御側プレイヤーは、自身のフィールドに存在する回復状態のスピリット1体を疲労させることで、ブロックを宣言できる。(Actual text: Block Declaration)
english_translation_or_summary: The defending player can declare a block by exhausting 1 refreshed Spirit on their field.
supported_engine_behavior: No support for effect activation. Previous claim that 8-1-3 governed effect activation timing was a misattribution.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT govern ability activation, costs, or limit consumption. Effect activation is governed by Chapter 9.

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation_or_note: BP比べの結果、BPの低い方のスピリットが破壊される。(Actual text: Destruction of Spirits in Battle)
english_translation_or_summary: As a result of BP comparison, the Spirit with lower BP is destroyed.
supported_engine_behavior: No support for same-name limits. Previous claim that 8-1-6 governed same-name limits was a misattribution.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT govern ability restrictions or same-name pools. Governed by Rule Revision Announcements and Chapter 9.

original_japanese_quotation_or_note: General paper card game principle: cards moving from Field to other zones cease to be the same in-play object.
english_translation_or_summary: Cards leaving the field lose status, level, and active modifiers, becoming new objects upon re-entry.
supported_engine_behavior: Ordinary OPT resets upon leaving field. Engine tracks this via fresh placementId upon entering field.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Specific section number "6-1-3" is unverified in Ver. 17.0 raw PDF; behavior is implemented as an engine convention.

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (Contract Soul State Principle)
original_japanese_quotation_or_note: Contract Spirits depleted/destroyed remain on field in Soul State; contract advent cards remain under-cards on field.
english_translation_or_summary: Contract cards in Soul State or as pre-advent under-cards remain on the field and retain physical instance identity.
supported_engine_behavior: Preserves placementId and consumed limits while a card continuously remains on field as Soul State or under-card.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Specific subsection numbers "10-2-1" and "10-3-2" unverified in raw PDF; treated as engine convention.

document_title: Battle Spirits Official Floor Rules (フロアルール)
original_japanese_quotation_or_note: エラッタが適用されたカードは、過去のすべての印刷版において最新の公式テキストとして扱われます。
english_translation_or_summary: Cards with official errata applied are treated as bearing the latest official text across all prior printings.
supported_engine_behavior: Reprints and errata versions share identical semantic descriptors and limits.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does not treat differing card names as equivalent.
